description:
Make a timeless statement with the French Country Crib featuring a panel-style front from Old Time Oak. The solid raised panel headboard adds warmth and architectural depth, creating a cozy, inviting focal point for your baby's room.
This 4-in-1 convertible crib is handcrafted from solid wood with the same attention to detail that defines the entire French Country collection. Transition seamlessly from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed as your child grows, making this a single investment that serves your family for years. Three adjustable mattress height settings provide flexibility and safety from newborn to toddler.
The panel-style front offers a more substantial, furniture-like appearance that complements both traditional and farmhouse-inspired nurseries. Finished with non-toxic, baby-safe materials and rigorously tested to exceed CPSC and ASTM standards. Available in ten beautiful finishes. Pair with the full French Country collection for a completely coordinated nursery.
